entry_state: The cited fields supply distinct accounting, database, identification, language, extraction and solver contributions. Their limits leave an integration problem rather than an established novel or superior product; architecture must connect those contributions through a shared representation and testable alternatives.
exit_state: A shared typed representation supports several authoring methods and explicit adapters. Core evidence, accounting and uncertainty semantics remain AccDSL responsibilities; the mathematical chapter must now define historical compatibility and future simulation precisely.
findings: The diagram preserves the source record through representation, compatible histories, scenarios and reports. The60/40 assumed loan split remains separate from the reported100.

The typed-library baseline can implement the whole product; the DSL decision is reversible and requires shared conformance cases. Optional component descriptions are dated source inspections, not executed integrations.

Adapters return typed events or measures without choosing accounting recognition or mutating journals. No new confirmed structural or rendered defect; current dependency adoption and runtime behavior are not established here.
